description: Synthetic credit compliance policy for Module 1 testing.

rules.name: maximum_facility_amount
rules.description: The total loan facility amount must not exceed INR 8 crore for standard term loans.

rules.name: minimum_interest_rate
rules.description: The interest rate on any new loan must be at least 9% per annum.

rules.name: minimum_dscr
rules.description: The borrower must maintain a minimum Debt Service Coverage Ratio (DSCR) of 1.25.

rules.name: collateral_required
rules.description: All term loans must be secured by tangible collateral valued at a minimum of 1.5x the facility amount.
